name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone said it. I rewrote my profile based on this and got 3x more matches in a week. The part about avoiding group photos was eye-opening.

name: Sarah M.
text: Disagree with the 'be funny' advice. Most guys trying to be funny just come off as trying too hard. Authenticity matters way more.

name: James K.
text: Question: does this apply equally to men and women? I feel like the dating app game is totally different depending on gender.

name: Emma L.
text: I tried the mirror selfie swap suggestion and honestly it made a huge difference. My matches increased AND the quality of conversations improved.

name: David P.
text: The real issue is that apps are oversaturated now. Even with a perfect profile, you're competing against thousands. Just my two cents.
